design.cue: I can see the white squeegee. Where are the black and blue ones? Please bring both here and leave each on one of these two fixed tables.
design.premise: Three otherwise identical squeegees are distinguished only by black, blue, and white tint. White and the matching box lid begin on separate kitchen counters. The wearer packs black, carries the box beside blue and packs it too, puts the lid on the box, and stores the closed box in a cabinet in one living room. White is later moved to a breakfast table in the adjacent living room before the wearer returns to ask. The successful branch opens the stored box, places black beside white on that breakfast table, and leaves blue on the nearby console table.
